note: What the leads of the evaluator's corpora really are (2026-10-01, docs/evaluateur.fr.md, E5.0): for each finding of the scripted detectors (and each form they leave unclassified), the verdict on what the finding says (right; wrong: its class or its cause is not what happened; stale: it was true, it is fixed since; unsure: not established; for a form left unclassified, right when nothing knowable classes it, wrong when a known cause was missed), the true cause and class, whether it is still true, and how certain the label is (established: worked out with a person, or shown by a fact a reader can check; likely: a strong reading, not shown; unknown: no verdict). Every label says who made it and how. The precision of the detectors is measured on these labels (scripts/evaluator/precision.mjs, tests/evaluator-labels.test.ts); a diagnosis by a reasoner (E5) is calibrated on them. Labels drafted by Claude and not yet confirmed by a person say so (confirmed: false).
